title: Signature Overlay Director — Director concept
description: The Signature Overlay Director is Manon's original frame-pacing conductor: it treats every rendered frame as an event with a timestamp, a budget, and a verdict. Telemetry is evidence, and the Director is its courtroom.

title: Signature Overlay Director — The frame ledger

title: Signature Overlay Director — Millisecond honesty

title: Signature Overlay Director — Precision limiter
description: The precision limiter paces frames against the display's measured refresh with sub-millisecond accuracy, learning the panel's real timing in calibration. Caps can be fractional — 141.7, not just 142 — because the math supports it.
